title: Reading Between the Lines
text:
Poetry often asks readers to slow down. Unlike a news article, a poem rarely states its message directly; instead, it uses images, rhythm, and carefully chosen words to suggest meaning. Many readers find this frustrating at first, yet the effort can be rewarding.

Consider a short poem about a winter street. The poet might describe a single lamp and footprints in the snow without ever mentioning loneliness. Because the reader must supply the feeling, the poem becomes a shared experience rather than a simple report.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does a poem usually do instead of stating its message directly?
options: It uses images, rhythm, and carefully chosen words
It gives a clear list of facts
It repeats the message several times

questions.text: What does the poet describe in the winter street poem?
options: A crowded market and loud traffic
A single lamp and footprints in the snow

questions.text: What can be inferred about why readers may find poetry frustrating at first?
options: They dislike reading anything written in English
They are not used to looking for meaning beneath the surface
Poems are always too long to finish

questions.text: Why does the poem become a shared experience, according to the second paragraph?
options: Everyone reads the poem aloud together
The poet asks readers to write a reply
The poem is printed in many languages
Readers bring their own feelings to fill the gaps

vocabulary.definition: a regular pattern of sounds or beats in a poem
causing annoyance or a feeling of being blocked

paragraph_translations: Поезія часто змушує читача сповільнитися. На відміну від новинної статті, вірш рідко прямо називає свою думку; натомість він використовує образи, ритм і ретельно підібрані слова, щоб натякнути на значення. Спочатку багато читачів вважають це дратівливим, але зусилля може бути вартим того.

Розгляньмо короткий вірш про зимову вулицю. Поет може описати одиночний ліхтар і сліди на снігу, ніколи не згадуючи про самотність. Оскільки читач мусить сам передати почуття, вірш стає спільним досвідом, а не простим описом.
